12522.name: Cam Ward
12522.headline: Titans' Week 6 trip to Indianapolis follows 0-5 start

In that game Ward completed 23 of 36 passes for 170 yards with no touchdowns and an interception, and he was sacked four times. The Titans' schedule had them at Indianapolis in Week 6 (Oct. 18), but this refresh could not find a confirmed Week 6 stat line or result for Ward. In redraft, he is not a starting option until the offense shows it can score. In superflex dynasty, a second-year starter with a long runway still matters, and selling at his lowest value rarely pays off. Hold him, and watch for any benching talk or a 2027 QB draft pick before changing that view.

13269.name: Fernando Mendoza
13269.headline: Kubiak 'thinking about everything' after Raiders' fourth straight loss
13269.news: Mendoza did not play in Las Vegas' 35-21 home loss to the Rams on Oct 25, the Raiders' fourth loss in a row, which drops them to 3-4. Asked about switching to the No. 1 overall pick, Klint Kubiak said the staff is "thinking about everything," including personnel, but did not announce a change. Kubiak said he didn't consider pulling Kirk Cousins late because the game was still competitive, and Cousins has started all seven games. Mendoza's only NFL action is still the Week 5 cameo at New England (6-of-8, 48 yards). The Raiders play at the Jets on Nov 1.
13269.take: This is the clearest signal yet that a switch could come soon, but nothing is official, and the Raiders may also wait until after a game or two. If Mendoza starts against the Jets, he's a superflex/2QB stash with modest early upside behind a struggling offense, not a 1QB starter. In dynasty, this is the last week to buy him before he's named the starter. Because the Raiders are losing, his starting job should stick for the rest of the year once it begins.

In dynasty this is a reasonable time to buy, since his price is depressed by the injury and he was a top-10 pick.

9502.name: Tank Dell
9502.headline: 43-yard catch in return; Noel's turf toe could open snaps
9502.news: Dell played on Oct 25 for the first time since his December 2024 multi-ligament knee injury, in Houston's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants. Noel's injury and the bye give Dell two weeks to get more practice and a possible path to more snaps in Week 9. Don't start him yet, but he's worth stashing on redraft benches in deeper leagues. In dynasty, buy him before a breakout game raises his price. Before the injury he had 98 catches for 1,376 yards and 10 TDs in 25 games.
